# cafournier.com

> Personal site of Charles-Adrien Fournier, indie iOS developer in Paris, France. Home of FridgeBuddy (pantry inventory and food expiration tracker for iPhone and iPad) and other iOS apps, plus articles about iOS development.

## FridgeBuddy — food expiration tracker & pantry inventory app

- [FridgeBuddy overview](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/): Features, screenshots, App Store rating, and FAQ for the iPhone/iPad app that tracks pantry, fridge, and freezer inventory with barcode and expiration-date scanning, household sharing via iCloud, and food-waste insights. Free with optional in-app purchases, requires iOS/iPadOS 26+.
- [Food expiration tracker guide](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/food-expiration-tracker/): How FridgeBuddy turns printed dates into reminders and a use-first list.
- [Pantry inventory app guide](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/pantry-inventory-app/): Organizing fridge, freezer, and pantry stock in one searchable inventory.
- [Shared pantry app guide](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/shared-pantry-app/): One shared household inventory and shopping lists for families and roommates.
- [Pantry app comparison](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/alternatives/): FridgeBuddy, NoWaste, Pantry, What The Fridge?!, and ExpiresBy compared by platform, input method, sharing, and ideal use case, with a stated research date.
- [Food-waste cost calculator](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/food-waste-calculator/): Free client-side calculator estimating the annual cost of avoidable household food waste.
- [FridgeBuddy 2.34: Fruits and vegetables](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy-2-34): October 2026 release article with short screen recordings: suggested expiration dates for fruits and vegetables based on USDA FoodKeeper storage times, notes on items, and quicker shopping lists.
- [FridgeBuddy 2.35: Undo](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy-2-35): October 2026 release article with short screen recordings: undo a consume, throw away or delete in one tap (or by shaking the iPhone), reopening on the last tab and shopping list after iOS closes the app in the background, and a region-independent CSV export.
- [FridgeBuddy privacy policy](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/privacypolicy): No accounts, no ads, no tracking; inventory stored in the user's private iCloud.

## FridgeBuddy en français

- [FridgeBuddy (FR)](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/fr/): Présentation en français de l'application de suivi des dates de péremption et d'inventaire de cuisine pour iPhone et iPad.
- [Suivi des dates de péremption](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/fr/suivi-date-peremption/): Guide en français du scan et des rappels de péremption.
- [Inventaire de cuisine](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/fr/inventaire-cuisine/): Guide en français de l'inventaire placards, frigo et congélateur.
- [Inventaire partagé](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/fr/inventaire-partage/): Guide en français du partage d'inventaire en famille ou en colocation.
- [Comparatif d'applications](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/fr/comparatif/): Comparatif en français de cinq apps d'inventaire et de péremption.
- [Calculateur de gaspillage alimentaire](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/fr/calculateur-gaspillage-alimentaire/): Calculateur gratuit du coût annuel du gaspillage évitable.

## FridgeBuddy auf Deutsch

- [FridgeBuddy (DE)](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/de/): Deutsche Übersicht der MHD- und Vorratsverwaltungs-App für iPhone und iPad.
- [MHD-Tracker](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/de/mhd-tracker/): Deutscher Guide zum Scannen von Mindesthaltbarkeitsdaten und zu Erinnerungen.
- [Vorratsverwaltung](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/de/vorratsverwaltung/): Deutscher Guide zur Verwaltung von Vorrat, Kühlschrank und Gefrierschrank.
- [Geteilter Vorrat](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/de/geteilter-vorrat/): Deutscher Guide zum geteilten Haushaltsvorrat für Familie und WG.
- [App-Vergleich](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/de/vergleich/): Deutscher Vergleich von fünf Vorrats- und MHD-Apps.
- [Lebensmittelverschwendung-Rechner](https://cafournier.com/fridgebuddy/de/lebensmittelverschwendung-rechner/): Kostenloser Rechner für die jährlichen Kosten vermeidbarer Verschwendung.

## FitnessStats — workout statistics for Apple Health

- [FitnessStats overview](https://cafournier.com/fitnessstats/): Features, screenshots, and FAQ for the iPhone app that turns Apple Health workouts into statistics, route heatmaps, distance trophies, heart rate zones, and monthly and yearly Recaps, shares any workout as an image or a route video, and exports a private training summary for ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Free with an optional one-time Premium purchase, requires iOS 26+.

## Apps

- [All apps](https://cafournier.com/#apps): Current iOS apps on the App Store, including Steed (bike maintenance log), LaterMark (bookmark manager), Clashly (bracket maker), Tierly (tier list maker), and NoExif (photo compressor).

## Articles

- [Blog](https://cafournier.com/blog/): Articles about iOS development, Swift, and indie app projects.
- [FitnessStats 2.8: Share your workouts](https://cafournier.com/fitnessstats-2-8): October 2026 release article with short screen recordings for FitnessStats, the Apple Health workout statistics app: a share editor that turns any workout into an image or a video where the route draws itself (triathlon legs included), and Export to AI, which copies a private summary of the user's training for ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.
